text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after running outside campus,

Nakayama Festa asks that we take a
little break
at a place nearby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone," she says... But then, I
suddenly realize
all the hustle and
bustle going on around us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Breaking a sweat on that ramped
track
makes this treat taste way more
delicious! ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that, Spe. You've
figured out a
good way for you to
handle hills.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Now that I get so amped when I
see a long
or steep slope, running over
them has become so
easy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how hard you push, you
always
start hearing the footsteps
behind you closing the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But that's a point we should really
consider.
We may be able to use it to
our advantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume chatting nearby sound
like
they've just been training too.
Hearing their
excitement, I can't help
but feel...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of how wonderful your
days of
youth are. I share my thoughts
with Nakayama
Festa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a curt response, she simply smiles.

The next day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, she's suddenly
improved... and I
think I might know why.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Breaktime discussions are a rich source
of
information.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I know where they get their thrill. Now I
just need
to use that knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm left speechless by Nakayama Festa's
cunning.
